headline: NALCO Posts Record Q2 2027 Profit as Expansion Push Drives Growth
summary: NALCO reported a 28 percent surge in second-quarter profit for fiscal 2027, driven by an ongoing expansion push despite a slight slip in its stock price.
why: NALCO is a major metals and mining enterprise whose earnings reflect domestic industrial demand and commodity pricing trends.
